description: Implement swipeable media carousel in PostCard for multi-media posts, update AppStack route params to pass initialMediaIndex, and update PostDetailScreen to accept and use it.
steps: 1. Update AppStackParamList in mobile/src/navigation/AppStack.tsx: Change PostDetail params from `{ postId: string }` to `{ postId: string; initialMediaIndex?: number }` to support passing the current carousel index when navigating from the feed.

2. Update PostDetailScreen in mobile/src/screens/post/PostDetailScreen.tsx: (a) Update the RouteProp type to include `initialMediaIndex?: number`. (b) Extract `initialMediaIndex` from route.params (default 0). (c) Initialize the `currentIndex` state with `initialMediaIndex` instead of 0. (d) Add a ref to the FlatList and use `initialScrollIndex={initialMediaIndex}` prop, plus `getItemLayout` for the FlatList to enable instant scroll to the correct index on mount.

3. Rewrite the media section of PostCard in mobile/src/components/home/PostCard.tsx: (a) Add a `currentMediaIndex` state (default 0). (b) Add a FlatList ref. (c) Replace the single TouchableWithoutFeedback+Image block with a horizontal FlatList that renders all items in `post.media`. (d) FlatList props: `horizontal`, `pagingEnabled`, `showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}`, `snapToInterval={cardWidth}` (use Dimensions or onLayout to get the card width), `decelerationRate='fast'`, `getItemLayout` for performance. (e) Track current index using `onMomentumScrollEnd` (calculate index from contentOffset.x / cardWidth). (f) Each item in the FlatList is wrapped in a `TouchableWithoutFeedback` that calls `handleImageTap` for that specific item (preserving double-tap-to-like and single-tap-to-navigate behavior PER media item). (g) For image items: render `<Image source={{ uri: item.url }} style={styles.image} resizeMode='cover' />`. For video items: render the video thumbnail with `getVideoThumbnailUrl(item.url)` and show a play icon overlay. (h) The heart animation overlay (`Animated.View` with heart icon) should be positioned absolutely over the FlatList container (not per-item) so it shows over the current visible media item. (i) The media count badge stays in its current position (top-right, absolute) over the FlatList container.

4. Add pagination dots below the FlatList in PostCard: (a) Only render if `post.media.length > 1`. (b) Row of small circles (6px diameter), centered horizontally below the media. (c) Active dot: accent color or white (matching the dark theme - use #FFFFFF for active). (d) Inactive dots: rgba(255,255,255,0.4). (e) Use the same dot styling pattern as PostDetailScreen (6px width, 6px height, borderRadius 3, marginHorizontal 3).

5. Update the single-tap navigation in PostCard's handleImageTap to pass the current media index: Change `navigation.navigate('PostDetail', { postId: post._id })` to `navigation.navigate('PostDetail', { postId: post._id, initialMediaIndex: currentMediaIndex })`.

6. Ensure backward compatibility: Posts with only 1 media item should render identically to before (single image, no dots, no FlatList overhead - OR still use FlatList with 1 item which is visually identical). The FlatList approach with 1 item is acceptable since it's functionally identical.
acceptance_criteria: Posts with multiple media items show a swipeable horizontal carousel in the feed
Pagination dots appear below the media for multi-media posts (not for single-media posts)
The media count badge (layers icon + count) remains visible in the top-right corner for multi-media posts
Double-tap on any media item in the carousel triggers the like animation and like action
Single-tap on any media item navigates to PostDetail with the current carousel index passed as initialMediaIndex
PostDetailScreen starts at the correct media index when opened from a specific carousel position
AppStackParamList includes optional initialMediaIndex in PostDetail params
Video items in the carousel show a thumbnail with play icon overlay
Heart animation displays over the current visible media item
verification: Run `cd /projects/sandbox/artnepalaya-monorepo/mobile && npx tsc --noEmit` to verify TypeScript compilation passes with no errors in the modified files
Verify the AppStackParamList type includes initialMediaIndex by reading AppStack.tsx
Verify PostDetailScreen reads initialMediaIndex from params and uses it for FlatList initialScrollIndex
Verify PostCard renders a horizontal FlatList for media with pagination dots
findings: All pre-existing TypeScript errors in the project are due to missing type declarations (node_modules not installed in this INTEGRATIONS_ONLY environment). My changes introduced zero new errors - verified by stashing changes and comparing error output before/after. The FlatList carousel uses SCREEN_WIDTH for snap interval and item width, matching the PostDetailScreen pattern. The renderMediaItem callback uses useCallback for performance. The handleImageTap function is shared across all carousel items (not per-item) since the double-tap/single-tap refs are at the component level - this works correctly because only one item is interactable at a time.
